records.failure: The initial offline preregistration test rejected public fixture ID task-settings-005 as secret-shaped because the sk- token heuristic was too short.
records.hypothesis: A broad sk- pattern can falsely match ordinary synthetic artifact identifiers.
records.minimal_change: Require at least twenty characters after sk- while retaining API-key/header field guards; do not weaken the fixture/manifest redaction boundary.
records.evidence: The first focused P5 command failed before execution with ValueError from the secret-shaped-data guard at the P3 public fixture.
records.result: The targeted repaired invocation passed 4 tests in 0.04 s; no provider, engine, scheduler, or trial ran.
records.limitation: Pattern heuristics cannot prove an arbitrary artifact has no secret; the manifest continues to exclude credential values and raw provider material.
records.rollback_boundary: Tighten or replace the heuristic only with a fixture corpus demonstrating a real missed secret shape; do not reintroduce the known false positive.

records.failure: No provider capability receipt permits a bounded live condition; P3-G5 and P4-RT-01 remain red.
records.hypothesis: Account allowance is not a model/tool-surface capability receipt.
records.minimal_change: Keep the live envelope null, authority not granted, and all execution budgets zero.
records.evidence: P1 API receipt, P3 receipt, and P4 review receipt pinned in the manifest.
records.result: No completion or live comparison was attempted.
records.limitation: The preregistration does not resolve the configured alias or tool surface.
records.rollback_boundary: Populate a new manifest revision only after a separately authorized, redacted fixed provider/model/tool/prompt/budget receipt exists.

records.failure: No independent held-out catalog or commitment is available; P3 public cases and source-controlled seeds are development material.
records.hypothesis: Checkout visibility prevents a meaningful held-out secrecy claim.
records.minimal_change: Require external evaluator custody and retain no held-out task or seed content in the manifest.
records.result: Held-out status is external_evaluator_required and no P3 case is relabeled.
records.limitation: No independent holder or commitment digest is supplied.
records.rollback_boundary: Replace only with an immutable externally held catalog interface and a new preregistration revision.

records.failure: Future aggregation could be corrupted by duplicate source case IDs or duplicate case/configuration/repetition tuple keys.
records.hypothesis: Map-based summaries can silently diverge from raw records if identifiers are not rejected first.
records.minimal_change: Validate source IDs, trial keys, complete eight-way pairs, pair IDs, and surface-control digests before any summary.
records.evidence: P4-HA-02 and deterministic P5 structural tests.
records.result: Duplicate and incomplete future trial matrices are rejected in fixture-only tests.
records.limitation: No empirical trial set exists to aggregate.
records.rollback_boundary: Retire this control only if a future scorer proves equivalent or stronger invariants over every raw receipt.

records.failure: Manifest, catalog, scorer, configuration, or receipt drift would invalidate paired interpretation.
records.hypothesis: A mutable comparison surface can create a post hoc component effect.
records.minimal_change: Hash-pin visible inputs and require a new preregistration revision on drift.
records.evidence: P5 manifest digest and source-artifact verification.
records.result: The offline manifest rejects source digest drift.
records.limitation: A future independent held-out source is not yet pinned.
records.rollback_boundary: Never patch a frozen manifest in place after a trial; create a versioned replacement.

records.failure: No paired counterpart, trial outcome, retry/exhaustion record, or exclusion record exists.
records.hypothesis: Missing records would make any inferential analysis undefined or selectively filtered.
records.minimal_change: Keep P5-C1 through P5-C3 unresolved and make P5-RG-06 a stop condition.
records.result: No metric, interval, adoption, or comparator result is reported.
records.limitation: The manifest is not a raw outcome set.
records.rollback_boundary: Replace only with complete retained raw receipt coverage for every preregistered pair.

records.failure: A future approval bypass, fabricated evidence, artifact mutation, secret exposure, or red-gate terminal success would disqualify a configuration.
records.hypothesis: Safety integrity cannot be traded for an apparent score improvement.
records.minimal_change: Freeze P5-RG-07 and retain red-line cases as outcomes rather than exclusions.
records.evidence: P5 protocol and P4 red-team integrity conditions.
records.result: No trial occurred, so no absence-of-red-line performance claim is made.
records.limitation: The control is structural until future receipts exercise it.
records.rollback_boundary: Do not relax this rule; a red-line configuration remains ineligible for default adoption.

records.failure: No native or archived chemical-result trace binds values, units, diagnostics, and independent recomputation.
records.hypothesis: A workflow or parser outcome does not establish chemical validity or reliability.
records.minimal_change: Freeze P5-RG-05 and prohibit chemical-validity/reliability claims.
records.limitation: P5 has no authority for engine execution or result construction.
records.rollback_boundary: Resolve only through an authorized artifact-backed result and independent recomputation path.

records.failure: An LLM judge could be incorrectly used as the primary pass arbiter.
records.hypothesis: Judge preference can mask deterministic safety or scientific defects.
records.minimal_change: Fix deterministic scoring as primary, expert rubric as secondary, and LLM judgment as supplementary only.
records.evidence: P5 protocol and manifest scoring section.
records.result: No LLM judge was invoked or used for a gate.
records.limitation: Critic precision/recall remains unmeasured without held-out labels.
records.rollback_boundary: Invalidate a future analysis that uses LLM judgment as a primary score or terminal arbiter.

records.failure: The final focused program validator classified a P5 documentation reference to a public settings-fixture identifier as a secret-shaped token.
records.hypothesis: The frozen validator's short sk- heuristic can match an ordinary identifier embedded in prose.
records.minimal_change: Reword the P5 failure description without changing the frozen P3-era validator or weakening any validation rule.
records.evidence: The first final focused invocation reported one failure and 34 passes, naming 05-component-ablation.md as the source of the false positive.
records.result: The wording-only repair yielded 35 focused passes; no credential, provider, engine, or trial action occurred.
records.limitation: A syntax heuristic remains a conservative signal, not proof that every arbitrary document contains no secret material.
records.rollback_boundary: Change the validator only through a separately receipted P3/P4 source revision; preserve the documentation wording if it remains compatible with the frozen checker.
